newsitem.title: USA: Sweetener Users disappointed by US sugar quota.
newsitem.headline: Sweetener Users disappointed by US sugar quota.

text.p: The head of the Sweetener Users Association said the U.S. sugar import quota set Friday by the Agriculture Department might be too small to assure adequate supplies or fair prices.
Tom Hammer, president of the trade group, said he was concerned the fiscal year quota of 2.3 million tonnes "will not provide relief" from tight supplies and high prices.
"We'll have to go in and fight quarter to quarter for some semblence of adequate supplies," Hammer said, referring to USDA's plan of regular reviews and possible adjustment of the quota.
